entities.summary: Bakaffa birth name: Missah; throne name Aṣma Giyorgis , later Masih Sagad was Emperor of Ethiopia from 18 May 1721 to 19 September 1730, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty. He was a son of Emperor Iyasu I and brother to Emperors Tekle Haymanot I and Dawit III.
